g.title: Figure title
g.text: Stage S2a -- late fusion, one visual soft token on the batch axis
Vision is introduced as a sibling series, not as a step in time. Chronos stays frozen; only the V-JEPA to Chronos mapping is learned.

g.title: Input tensors
g.text: the 12 ahead are known, not predicted
8 RGB frames over a 6 h window

g.title: Per-modality front ends
g.text: out: patched context and per-patch mask
plus (loc, scale), kept for the inverse
each covariate channel becomes its own
token row on the batch axis (mask = 1)
motion is encoded inside the encoder

g.title: Projection into the 512-d token space
g.text: shared by the target row and all 14 covariate rows; the horizon patch uses embed_future
patch in = patch out = 16, so no separate future_patch_embedding is built
784 patch tokens down to ONE vector

g.title: MultimodalEmbedding
g.text: MultimodalEmbedding (additive tags, FROM SCRATCH) + RoPE position ids
modality {num = 0, vis = 1} + segment {context, horizon} + token-type {target, covariate, visual} + entity id
shape preserving. Modality dropout randomly zeroes the visual stream during training, so the model cannot lean on it blindly.

g.title: Late fusion
g.text: the visual summary is projected into 1 soft token and appended as an extra ROW on the BATCH axis,
sharing a group_id with the target row. Vision is therefore a sibling series, not a step in time.
The time sequence itself stays purely numeric, which is why the frozen backbone still accepts it.
out: [B, 43, 512] + 1 visual row on the batch axis

g.title: Chronos2Encoder
g.text: Chronos2Encoder -- x6 identical blocks (d_model 512, 8 heads, d_kv 64, d_ff 2048) FROZEN in S2a
The visual row runs through this
too, but as its own row.
this is where vision enters in S2a
acts on the BATCH axis, not time.
Fuses the target row with the 14
Block k feeds block k + 1; block 6

g.title: Output head, forecast and loss
g.text: reads the target rows only; visual rows are dropped
valid horizon steps only; night is masked
reported as NMAE, NRMSE, Skill Score
last T_hor hidden states, target rows only: [B, 1, 512]
